data.text: Everyone has now agreed: John and Kate will take 12 tons each, Jack and Emma 10 each, and I’ll take 6. That means $12,000 each for John and Kate, $10,000 each for Jack and Emma, and $6,000 for me, with 50 tons left to replenish the lake. I also support returning to 10 tons each next month; we can confirm that together before our next choices.
